subject: math
question:
设 $f(x)$ 和 $g(x)$ 在 $[0,1]$ 上的导数连续，且 $f(0) = 0$ ， $f'(x) \geqslant 0$ ， $g'(x) \geqslant 0$ 。证明对 $\forall a \in [0,1]$ ，有

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {a} g (x) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \geqslant f (a) g (1).
$$
answer: $$ \int_ {0} ^ {a} g (x) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \geqslant f (a) g (a) + f (a) [ g (1) - g (a) ] = f (a) g (1). $$

steps.text: 分析 两边做差，将参数 $a$ 作为自变量引入辅助函数，再用函数的单调性证明；也可做分部积分，化简左端积分式.

方法1 设 $F(x) = \int_{0}^{x} g(t) f'(t) \, \mathrm{d}t + \int_{0}^{1} f(t) g'(t) \, \mathrm{d}t - f(x) g(1)$ ，则 $F(x)$ 在[0,1]上的导数连续，并且

$$
F ^ {\prime} (x) = g (x) f ^ {\prime} (x) - f ^ {\prime} (x) g (1) = f ^ {\prime} (x) [ g (x) - g (1) ].
$$

由于当 $x \in [0,1]$ 时， $f'(x) \geqslant 0$ ， $g'(x) \geqslant 0$ ，因此 $F'(x) \leqslant 0$ ，即 $F(x)$ 在 $[0,1]$ 上单调递减。注意到

$$
F (1) = \int_ {0} ^ {1} g (t) f ^ {\prime} (t) \mathrm{d} t + \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (t) g ^ {\prime} (t) \mathrm{d} t - f (1) g (1),
$$

而

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {1} g (t) f ^ {\prime} (t) \mathrm{d} t = \int_ {0} ^ {1} g (t) \mathrm{d} f (t) = g (t) f (t) \big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (t) g ^ {\prime} (t) \mathrm{d} t = f (1) g (1) - \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (t) g ^ {\prime} (t) \mathrm{d} t.
$$

故 $F(1) = 0$ ，因此当 $x\in [0,1]$ 时， $F(x)\geqslant 0$ ．由此可得对任何 $a\in [0,1]$ ，有

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {a} g (x) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \geqslant f (a) g (1).
$$

方法 2 做分部积分化简右端的积分式.

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {a} g (x) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x = g (x) f (x) \big | _ {0} ^ {a} - \int_ {0} ^ {a} f (x) g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x = f (a) g (a) - \int_ {0} ^ {a} f (x) g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x.
$$

从而

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {0} ^ {a} g (x) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x & = f (a) g (a) - \int_ {0} ^ {a} f (x) g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = f (a) g (a) + \int_ {a} ^ {1} f (x) g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x. \end{array}
$$

由于当 $x \in [0,1]$ 时， $g'(x) \geqslant 0$ ，因此 $f(x)g'(x) \geqslant f(a)g'(x)$ ， $x \in [a,1]$ ，有

$$
\int_ {a} ^ {1} f (x) g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \geqslant \int_ {a} ^ {1} f (a) g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x = f (a) [ g (1) - g (a) ].
$$

从而

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {a} g (x) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \geqslant f (a) g (a) + f (a) [ g (1) - g (a) ] = f (a) g (1).
$$

solution.final_answer: $$ \int_ {0} ^ {a} g (x) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) g ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \geqslant f (a) g (a) + f (a) [ g (1) - g (a) ] = f (a) g (1). $$
